description: Configure an input processing chain for the 'solar_pv' input (node: 'home') to monitor inverter clipping. The inverter clips at 3600W. You need to create a chain that: 1) Logs the raw generation to a feed named 'solar_raw_W', 2) Calculates the excess power above 3600W (subtract 3600, then allow only positive values), 3) Logs this excess to a feed named 'solar_excess_W', and 4) Converts the excess power to energy (kWh) in a feed named 'solar_lost_kwh'. All feeds should use the PHPFina engine with a 10s interval.
